purpose: Define the single handoff contract so context, ownership, and evidence survive chat boundaries.

ownership_modes.description: Execution ownership moves to the receiving chat after acceptance.
Receiving chat produces a bounded output while origin chat keeps primary ownership.
Receiving chat validates or approves an item without taking execution ownership.

handoff_kinds.description: Provide a required artifact, contract, or decision needed by another package.
Prepare evidence, compatibility data, or bundle ordering before merge.
Perform the bounded action that clears a reported blocker.

routing_rules.statement: Package chats do not deliver direct handoffs to other package chats.
routing_rules.enforcement: All cross-package tickets are opened into governance control and re-routed from there.

routing_rules.statement: A handoff targets exactly one receiving chat.
routing_rules.enforcement: Split multi-target needs into multiple tickets.

routing_rules.statement: A handoff carries a bounded outcome and acceptance criteria.
routing_rules.enforcement: Reject tickets without requested_outcome or acceptance_criteria.

routing_rules.statement: Resolved handoffs must attach evidence refs and a completion summary.
routing_rules.enforcement: A done ticket without evidence is invalid.
